summary: Real S8000 Linux kernel #5 generated EVDEV ABS_MT_TRACKING_ID, ABS_MT_POSITION_X/Y, BTN_TOUCH, SYN_REPORT events with finger motion and release after bounded manual EE, E3/D9, E7/D9 Type1, 9D/BF and AF SPI setup. IRQ142 rose from 1 to 25 during capture. Simultaneous multitouch and edge precision unverified; private calibration/firmware omitted.
